propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing can normalize structurally divergent provider output to empty results that are incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes

Raw-empty outcomes (provider returns empty list) and malformed-to-empty outcomes (provider returns garbage dropped by reshape) must both be rejected as verification results, regardless of which telemetry bucket they land in
Semantically empty verification results are already prevented from producing valid pass/fail reviews via pass3_decide's no-verification rule routing to indeterminate outcome
Telemetry must separately count clean parses, recovered parses, semantically empty outcomes, and unrecoverable responses at the kernel-function level (verify_findings)
Pipeline-level wiring to emit outcome_counts telemetry from plan_review_decide and code_review_decide is a separate follow-up concern
Flexible parsing and bounded retry/self-healing must be preserved while rejecting empty normalized responses
